A display commemorating 9/11 sits outside the Student Union on Wednesday, Sept. 10, 2025. (Sydney Herdle/UConn Photo)

The University of Connecticut will mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks with a number of special events on Friday, Sept. 11.

A University-wide remembrance ceremony will be held at noon in the Student Union Theatre. The event is being coordinated by University Safety and is open to all members of the University community and the general public. [...] The Storrs Congregational Church will ring its carillon bells at 8:46 a.m, the time of the first attack on the North Tower.
